Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹74.42 loss per share (down from ₹7.93 profit in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹145.8b (down 2.0% from FY 2025). Net loss: ₹19.0b (down ₹21.0b from profit in FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.8% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 100 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Upcoming dividend of ₹11.00 per share
news.body: Eligible shareholders must have bought the stock before 10 June 2026. Payment date: 26 July 2026. The company is not currently making a profit and there are not enough cash flows to support it either. Trailing yield: 1.5%. Within top quartile of Indian dividend payers (1.5%). Higher than average of industry peers (0.8%).

news.title: Dividend of ₹11.00 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹11.00 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 10th June 2026 Payment date: 26th July 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.5%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.8%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is not covered by earnings (139% earnings payout ratio) nor is it covered by cash flows (438% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. The company's earnings per share (EPS) would need to grow by 54% to bring the payout ratio under control. EPS is expected to grow by 651% over the next 3 years, which is sufficient to bring the dividend into a sustainable range.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹3.65 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹2.08 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹35.9b (flat on 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹930.0m (loss widened 76% from 3Q 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 3.9%. Earnings per share (EPS) were also behind analyst expectations. Revenue is forecast to grow 6.0% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Chemicals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 81 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.
